historical_supersession.older_claim: A3 publication-result ambiguity remained outside the A4 fix
historical_supersession.resolution: The exact baseline includes the later A3 field correction and named tests. Do not repeat the older red A3 claim for this result-field defect; independent production qualification remains unproven.

historical_supersession.older_claim: The original Person demo still used a fixture admission sidecar
historical_supersession.resolution: Demo R2 now wires PersonTwinAdmissionStore and denies sidecar/reader readmission. This is synthetic durable process continuity, not a Portable Twin Vault restore.
Issue metadata says completed; PR #211 and current scope limits do not establish 12-family production admission. Preserve both observations; no issue state mutation is performed.

families.title: Identity
families.implemented_scope: Deterministic twin_id from tenant/subject; exact owner/controller/ownership epoch, identity fingerprint and schema; validators reject production-admitted identity values.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Identity is consumed by R2, R3, the durable store and R4/R21H. Demo derives expected fixture identity from an external run ID before reading SQLite.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Independently authenticated subject/controller and trusted installation/root binding for a real pilot are not established by hashes or caller-supplied identifiers.
H3 C0 pre-send same-binding identity and native T11/T12 evidence remain separate; no production signoff is present in this reviewed evidence set.

families.title: Consent
families.implemented_scope: Immutable scope/purpose/time/principal-bound source-consent receipts, separate source-read and memory-admission authorities, and a separately hashed revocation ledger with fail-closed evaluation.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Consent is checked at R2 creation/read/export/lifecycle binding, every R3 admission boundary, R4 read authorization and final R21H prompt validation. Time and the current ledger are trusted host inputs.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Authenticate consent authority, trusted time and independently current revocation evidence for the selected pilot; historical receipts cannot supply a fresh grant.
Close or explicitly bound the revocation check-to-disclosure interval and authorize the exact model sink/egress.

families.title: Admission
families.implemented_scope: R3 stages STAGED -> VALIDATED -> COMMITTED_NOT_CURRENT -> POSTVERIFY_PASS -> CURRENT. The durable adapter commits pointer, publication and actual R3 receipt together, checks expected publication, reopens read-only and reports unknown outcomes as HOLD.
families.wiring_at_baseline: The durable store is wired into current Person demo R2 PREPARE/A/B; readers recover actual receipt bytes without rerunning admission. A3 result-field correction and A4 exact saved-row binding are present at this baseline.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Hostile database rollback/rewrites, generation/ABA handling, trusted origin and production storage-failure qualification are not established by this bounded SQLite composition.
No atomic transaction across external consent, admission state and model delivery is claimed; real-pilot authority and admission signoff remain separate.

families.title: Privacy
families.implemented_scope: PERSON_PRIVATE and PERSON_SHARED scopes bind an exact twin; implicit widening is rejected; retrieval rechecks consent and hides lineage references outside visible source records.
families.wiring_at_baseline: R2 is used by R4 and the explicit protected R21H evidence path. Generic R21H remains a distinct path and does not inherit Person qualification.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Prove the boundary for every route actually enabled in a real pilot, including filesystem/DB custody, exports, backups and model egress.
Protected FAST fixture success cannot qualify generic runtime, direct Memory, unrelated MCP or raw tool routes.

families.title: Provenance
families.implemented_scope: Person records bind source object/revision, observed/effective time, source content, actor/authority, tenant/twin, scope, consent, admission session and supersession/duplicate lineage. A4 binds exact saved Memory ID and namespace before selection.
families.wiring_at_baseline: R2 verifies against supplied source/consent anchors; R4 reads stored candidate/current bytes; R21H independently reads saved Memory binding during prepare and final prompt validation.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Authenticate source/issuer/time and preserve byte custody beyond trusted host inputs; hashes establish binding, not source authenticity.
A5 receipt provenance, A6 generation/ABA and exact database identity across independently supplied read stores remain separately scoped obligations.

families.title: Backup / Portable Twin Vault
families.implemented_scope: Generic Memory quiescent backup implements SQLite validation, byte-exact copy, manifest, hash/readback and bounded backup-root checks. It is useful existing code, not evidence of the complete Person Vault contract.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Person demo R2 persists admitted state in SQLite but explicitly excludes Portable Twin Vault restore. This reviewed repository set does not establish a Person-specific encrypted vault/portable custody path.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Specify and bind Person inclusion/exclusion, consent/privacy, encryption and key custody, deterministic portable manifest/content root and schema compatibility.
Verify complete authorized package coverage and independent readback for a synthetic vault before any real-data use.

families.title: Restore
families.implemented_scope: Generic restore validates the backup, pins target hash, requires confirmation and compatibility acknowledgement, preserves a preimage and performs atomic replacement/readback with explicit rollback failure handling.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Generic Memory tests exercise temporary SQLite restore. A3 documentation references an external backup -> revoke -> restore acceptance body, but that external receipt/body was not in the reviewed files. Person demo is not a vault restoration proof.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Bind a Person vault to restore, verify authorized state/count/hash/replay equivalence and preserve last-known-good/current promotion rules.
Reacquire a fresh independent revocation ledger after restore; restored historical consent cannot become current authority.
Identify and independently replay the external N4 evidence if it is used to close this family; its mention alone is insufficient.

families.title: Export
families.implemented_scope: R2 reuses the P2 deterministic export bundle after exact Person scope/consent filtering, adds a Person provenance manifest and binds the current revocation ledger hash. Output is read-only and NOT_PRODUCTION_ADMITTED.
families.wiring_at_baseline: The explicit Python export adapter exists and is tested. R4 supports READ/PROPOSE/APPROVE and deliberately excludes R5/effectful actions; the protected runtime does not make this a fully admitted export service.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Bind exact requester authorization, delivery destination, recipient scope and result readback for the chosen Person export path.
Qualify portable export/restore compatibility; an in-memory bundle and its hash are not proof of delivered or accepted export.

families.title: Lifecycle
families.implemented_scope: R2 binds one exact twin/record/scope target with fresh consent and physical_delete=false. P2 shared code supplies retention, hold, logical tombstone and advisory purge-eligibility primitives.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Person-specific read-only target binding is implemented; the inspected R4 policy rejects actions beyond READ/PROPOSE/APPROVE. A complete persistent Person lifecycle transaction is not established by this binding alone.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Demonstrate semantic reuse of P2 retention/hold/reference and tombstone-first history in the exact Person persistent path.
Bind owner authority and reconciliation for permitted lifecycle actions; no physical deletion is granted by this matrix.

families.title: Replay
families.implemented_scope: R4 derives a replay identity from source, admission, consent/ledger, principal/policy, session and authorization. It reads an external durable-replay interface, accepts exact bound replay and denies divergence. R21H has one-use request-phase checks.
families.wiring_at_baseline: The evaluator is read-only; demo uses _EmptyReplayFixture. No durable model-disclosure reservation/delivery ledger is supplied by this composition, and R21H does not claim cross-request delivery exactly once.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Supply and qualify durable atomic disclosure/replay custody across process restart, ambiguous delivery, concurrent requests and generation/ABA changes for the approved route.
Preserve unknown-delivery states and do not retry a possibly disclosed request automatically; restored-state equivalence remains a separate requirement.

families.title: Authority
families.implemented_scope: R4 combines R2, stored CURRENT readback, exact session/authorization bindings and P2 policy. Agent READ/PROPOSE are non-effectful; APPROVE requires a human authorization identity; EXECUTE and outside-R4 actions are denied.
families.wiring_at_baseline: Protected R21H FAST revalidates at prompt construction and rejects unsupported protected paths. Generic paths remain distinct; installed host/client enforcement and native H3 identity are not implied.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Authenticate the trusted host/intent/context inputs and independently qualified C0/H3 client/broker binding before real sensitive requests.
Prove all enabled paths and revocation/kill behavior under the separately approved pilot; no authority may be inferred from installation, context, CI, merge or a saved receipt.

families.title: Operator signoff
families.implemented_scope: Identity, admission, R4 and demo outputs explicitly retain NOT_PRODUCTION_ADMITTED and non-effectful ceilings. This enforces a negative claim; it is not an owner admission receipt.
families.wiring_at_baseline: No reviewed source or provider observation binds a human production-admission signoff to all 12 completed families on this exact commit/evidence set.
families.execution_evidence: Prior exact-baseline CI status observed (GCI); selected test definitions inspected. No node-level result artifact was reread and no runtime qualification was executed by this matrix audit.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Obtain a separate exact human signoff after required machine-verifiable and independent acceptance evidence is complete; name the actual acceptance owner from authority evidence.
A closed issue, merged PR, successful CI, this matrix or a synthetic demo cannot supply that signoff.

reviewed_absence_scope.method: Recursive ripgrep of Portable Twin/Vault, production admission/signoff, C0/T11/T12 and replay interface references, plus direct reading of the listed sources
reviewed_absence_scope.limit: No external laptop evidence directory, installed service, owner database, vault bytes or human signoff receipt was inspected by this matrix audit. Unlocated evidence is not asserted nonexistent globally.

validation_plan.effects: Temporary synthetic SQLite, bounded child Python processes and recording model fixtures; no live provider/owner database is required
known_platform_limits: Two product-demo venv/direct-interpreter cases require Windows and skip elsewhere.
Real symlink cases require the host to permit symlink creation; a skip is not a pass.
Separate cryptography-backed tests importorskip cryptography; standard CI installs its pinned backend for the selected real-crypto fixtures.
Unrelated full-suite HTTP tests bind loopback sockets; a blanket socket-deny policy is not compatible with the entire existing suite.
TPM/H3/PostgreSQL-named unit tests use fake providers in the reviewed selection; their success is not native/provider qualification.
validation_plan.release_gate: Existing Ubuntu/Windows review-gates on the exact candidate, including wheel identity and collected tests, plus separately required acceptance evidence. Never transfer old job success to changed source.
